description: nf-core/chipseq samplesheet context. Each ChIP row references a control row; samplesheet must include both.

pipeline.name: nf-core/chipseq
pipeline.core_rule: Required columns: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, antibody, control, control_replicate. Inputs/IgG controls must also appear as rows with empty antibody/control fields.

validation_rules: Each ChIP row's control value must match a sample row whose antibody field is empty (the input/IgG control).
control_replicate is the replicate number of that control sample.
fastq_1/fastq_2 may be HTTPS URLs (ENA mirror) or local paths.

population_priority: Identify ChIP vs Input rows from NExtSEEK metadata; emit Input rows first when possible.
Use accession_rows for fastq columns; pull antibody/control linkages from sample lineage when explicit.
